items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: I went and borrowed a bass from Dave Poiton, 75 cents.

ctx.x: Well I, the maker of a hoistel on a Sunday evening, I went and borrowed a bass from Dave Poiton, 75 cents. Got it on the street call. Made that rehearsal, we were right here on Ivorville. That's where this father was living. Either he was living there or his sister was living there. I think he was living around here. But they had a piano over there.
Is that the first time you ever played it? First time. Right at the rehearsal.
